swimming pools Indoor, Outdoor, Heated View all Located in the heart of Costa del Sol, within walking distance from the beach and a 15-minute drive from Marbella, Marbella Villas feature their own outdoor swimming pool, terrace, garden and barbecue facilities. Capobino Beach is a 5-minute drive away. The villas offer private parking and indoor and outdoor seating areas. Fitted with tile flooring, each villa has a flat-screen TV. The kitchen is equipped with an oven, microwave and washing machine. Each villa has private bathrooms with shower or bathtub. Guests have full access to Playa Real Club House. There is also an indoor pool, sauna gymnasium, and hot tub available to all guests, free of charge. Santa María Golf & Country Club is 2.1 mi from the villas. Málaga airport is 35 minutes away by car. Couples in particular like the location – they rated it **9.1** for a two-person trip. These villas are unique and ideal for families or groups of friends to enjoy. Whether you want to use the villa as a base and explore the area or just stay the whole week lying by your private pool...the choice is yours! Neighborhood info There are a couple of supermarkets in walking distance and beach restaurants. If the kids get bored of playing in the private pool and gardens that the villa has to offer then nearby there are many activities to do.Safari parks, Tree top climbing, water parks and dolphin shows are a few of the many attractions on the coast. Welcome to Marbella Villa 3, a beautifully designed beachfront condo located directly on the stunning Gulf beach of Anna Maria Island! This two-bedroom, two-bath retreat features breathtaking Gulf sunsets and scenic water vistas from your private balcony, perfectly suited for a romantic getaway, family vacation, or small group escape. Just steps from the soft sands and peaceful waters, enjoy an outdoor grill, water-view decks, and easy access to Bridge Street's shops, waterfront dining, and water sports rentals. The nearby trolley stop makes exploring Anna Maria Island effortless.

• Beachfront Condo

• 2 Bedroom / 2 Bathroom

• 1 King, 2 Queen beds

• Direct beach access

• Screened-in lanai

• Shared pool and spa

This condo offers an outdoor sanctuary with a private, screened-in balcony that overlooks the Gulf, offering breathtaking sunsets and water vistas. The complex features a shared pool, spa, and outdoor BBQ area with a gas grill perfect for family cookouts or romantic dinners. Dine amid tropical scenery and listen to the sound of water lapping at the shoreline. The property’s incredible water views, outdoor space, and walkable location make every day a memorable island experience.

Inside, the condo features a bright, modern layout with natural light streaming through large windows. The living room offers plush seating and a TV, perfect for relaxing or watching family movies. The fully stocked kitchen boasts contemporary appliances, a large breakfast bar, and elegant counters, providing the ideal space for island-inspired cooking. The adjacent dining table seats four and offers a scenic water backdrop for all your family meals.

Retreat to the primary suite, located on the water-facing side of the condo, with a king bed, a large water-view window, a TV, and a luxurious ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. The second bedroom offers two queen beds and scenic decor. The hall bathroom, with a shower and tub combo, adds convenience for additional guests. Both bedrooms feature premium linens and a calming ambiance to ensure restful nights.

Room Details

• Primary Bedroom: King bed, ensuite with walk-in shower

• Second Bedroom: Two queen beds

Walk along the shoreline or explore Bridge Street’s local shops, restaurants, and water sports rentals from your central island location.

# How guest reviews work

Each review score is between 1 and 10. To get the overall score you see, we add up all the review scores we’ve received and divide that total by the number of them. We use a weighted review system, which means the more recent the review, the bigger the impact on the total review score calculation. Guests can also give separate “subscores” in crucial areas like location, cleanliness, staff, comfort, facilities, value, and free Wifi. Note that guests submit their subscores and overall scores independently, so there’s no direct link between them.

You can review an accommodation that you booked through our platform if you stayed there, or if you got to the property but didn’t actually stay there. To edit a review you’ve already submitted, contact our Customer Service team.

We have people and automated systems that specialize in detecting fake reviews submitted to our platform. If we find any, we delete them and, if necessary, take action against whoever is responsible.

Anyone who spots something suspicious can always report it to our Customer Service team so that our fraud team can investigate.

Ideally, we'd publish every review we get, positive and negative. However, we won’t display any reviews that include or refer to (among other things):

- Politically sensitive comments
- Promotional content
- Illegal activities
- Personal or sensitive info (e.g. emails, phone numbers, credit card info)
- Swear words, sexual references, hate speech, discriminatory remarks, threats, or references to violence
- Spam and fake content
- Animal cruelty
- Impersonation (i.e. if the writer is claiming to be someone else)
- Any violation of our review guidelines.

To make sure reviews are relevant, we may only accept reviews that are submitted within 3 months of checking out. We may stop showing reviews once they’re 36 months old, or if the accommodation has a change of ownership.

An accommodation can reply to a review.

When you see multiple reviews, the most recent ones will be at the top, subject to a few other factors (e.g. language, whether it’s just a rating or contains comments as well, etc.). You can sort and/or filter them by time of year, review score, and more.

Sometimes we show external review scores from other well-known travel websites, but make it clear when we do this.

## Guidelines and Standards for Reviews

These guidelines and standards aim to keep the content on Booking.com relevant and family-friendly, without limiting expression or strong opinions. They're also applicable regardless of the comment's tone.

**Contributions should be travel related.** The most helpful contributions are detailed and help others make better decisions. Please don’t include personal, political, ethical, or religious commentary. Promotional content will be removed and issues concerning Booking.com’s services should be routed to our Customer Service or Accommodation Service teams.

**Contributions should be appropriate for a global audience.** Please avoid using profanity or attempts to approximate profanity with creative spelling, in any language. Comments and media that include hate speech, discriminatory remarks, threats, sexually explicit remarks, violence, or the promotion of illegal activity are not permitted.

**All content should be genuine and unique to the guest.** Reviews are most valuable when they are original and unbiased. Your contribution should be yours. Booking.com property partners should not post on behalf of guests or offer incentives in exchange for reviews. Attempts to bring down the rating of a competitor by submitting a negative review will not be tolerated.

**Respect the privacy of others.** Booking.com will make an effort to obscure email addresses, telephone numbers, website addresses, social media accounts, and other similar details.

**The opinions expressed in contributions are those of Booking.com customers and properties, and not of Booking.com. Booking.com does not accept responsibility or liability for any reviews or responses. Booking.com is a distributor (without any obligation to verify) and not a publisher of these comments and responses.**

By default, reviews are sorted based on the date of the review and on additional criteria to display the most relevant reviews, including but not limited to: your language, reviews with text, and non-anonymous reviews. Additional sorting options might be available (by type of traveler, by score, etc...).

- What are the best activities in Marbella?



There are so many great things to do in Marbella! Of course, you can't beat spending a day at the beach. Marbella has some of the best beaches in Spain, with soft sand and crystal-clear water. For a little excitement, try jet skiing or parasailing. And for a more relaxing experience, head to one of the many beach clubs and enjoy a delicious meal with a view.

- What are the best villa rentals in Marbella?





Among the villa rentals in Marbella, [Alojamientos Monteverde](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1257535), [La Casita By Teresa](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1050307) and [Golfers & Beach Villa With Heated Pool](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/11030376) are the most popular ones.

- What are the advantages of renting a house or a villa in Marbella



Renting a villa in Marbella can be a great way to experience the city like a local. You'll have more space and privacy than a hotel, and you can often find villas with private pools and gardens. This is especially great for families or groups of friends, as you can have your own space to relax and enjoy each other's company.

- What are the best villa rentals with a pool in Marbella?





[Alojamientos Monteverde](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1257535), [Golfers & Beach Villa With Heated Pool](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/11030376) and [Villa Marina](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1074930) are the best villa rentals with a pool in Marbella.

- What food festivals or culinary events take place in and around Marbella?



Marbella hosts several food festivals throughout the year, celebrating the region's delicious cuisine. The most popular is the Feria de San Bernabé in June, which features traditional Andalusian food and music. There's also the Marbella Gastronomy Week in October, which showcases the best restaurants in the city.

- What are the best villa rentals with a jacuzzi in Marbella?

- What exclusive experiences are available when visiting Marbella?



For a truly luxurious experience, you can book a private yacht charter and explore the stunning coastline. Or, if you're a golf enthusiast, you can play at one of Marbella's world-class golf courses. For a more unique experience, take a private cooking class and learn how to prepare some of the region's most famous dishes.

- What are the best villa rentals for families and kids in Marbella?

- Which part of Marbella would be ideal for a villa rental?

# Three Bedrooms Villa

[Marbella](https://www.casolvillasfrance.com/villa-rentals/spain/costa-del-sol/marbella.html "Marbella"), [Costa Del Sol](https://www.casolvillasfrance.com/villa-rentals/spain/costa-del-sol.html "Costa Del Sol"), [Spain](https://www.casolvillasfrance.com/villa-rentals/spain-villa-rentals.html "Spain")

_6 Guests, 3 Bedrooms, 3 Bathrooms, Pool, Terrace, Garden, Beach_

**[From €50,000 - €100,000 / week](https://www.casolvillasfrance.com/luxury-villa-rentals-contact.html "Book Now!")**

## Escape to Spain, Book Your Private Vacation at the Three-Bedroom Villa with Kitchen Inside the Marbella Club: An Elegant Home with Heated Swimming Pool, offering 550 m² (5,920 sq.ft) of Authentic Andalusian Sanctuary for 6 Guests with Casol.

**Discover** the laid-back charm and pure essence of Andalusia paired with world-class five-star service on Marbella’s legendary Golden Mile. True to the region’s original architecture, this luxury **Three-Bedroom Villa with Kitchen** is tucked within Santa Margarita, the exclusive gated enclave home to the resort's most private properties. Nestled in the mature, subtropical heart of the resort's gardens, this private villa is beautifully curated by Casol for discerning families or elite travelers looking for a perfect, seamless Mediterranean retreat.

**Enjoy** indoor-outdoor freedom in a warm, inviting sanctuary defined by classic elegance and timeless Spanish grace. The expansive 550 m² (5,920 sq.ft) layout features a fully equipped kitchen (complete with ceramic hob, microwave, dishwasher, oven, and fridge for complete independence) and an ample, airy living room centered around a cozy traditional wood-burning fireplace. The serene interiors open up effortlessly to your own private grounds, where a secluded garden lined with mature trees blends seamlessly into your personal paradise.

**Explore** an outdoor oasis built for creating legendary memories. Step outside to your private terrace and landscaped garden, enjoy a refreshing dip in your personal heated swimming pool, or dust off your sandy feet after a fun-filled day by the sea. Designed for ultimate comfort and true luxury, the villa perfectly accommodates a maximum of 6 guests across 3 luxury bedrooms, featuring a stunning upstairs master bedroom suite with its own private terrace. The bedding configuration consists of 2 King beds and 1 Twin bed. Pamper yourself in the 3 masterfully appointed bathrooms featuring double vanities, separate showers, and a luxurious bath equipped with Jacuzzi jets, complemented by premium bathroom amenities by Votary.

**Large group coming together?** Planning your beach wedding on the sunny Costa del Sol? The Marbella Club offers a legendary collection of bedrooms, suites, and private Andalusian-style villas spread along 42,000 square metres of lush subtropical gardens. Contact Casol to book neighboring 1 to 5-bedroom spaces to bring your entire party together seamlessly.

**Ready** to reserve the **Three-Bedroom Villa with Kitchen** inside the Marbella Club?
**[Contact Casol](https://www.casolvillasfrance.com/luxury-villa-rentals-contact.html "Contact Casol")**
today to live your private Mediterranean escape!

## Villa Specifications, Staff & Services

- **The Estate:**
An impressive 550 m² (5,920 sq.ft) private Andalusian oasis located in the secure, gated Santa Margarita section. Features a traditional white-washed architecture, private access, and total seclusion within the heart of the resort's gardens.

- **Accommodations:**
3 luxury bedrooms and 3 premium bathrooms welcoming up to 6 guests max. Layout includes an upstairs master suite with private terrace, offering a 2 King beds and 1 Twin bed configuration. Extra bed and cot are available upon request for family flexibility.

- **Spa & Bath:**
Bespoke bathrooms featuring double vanities, separate showers, a relaxing bath with integrated Jacuzzi jets, and exclusive bathroom amenities by Votary.

- **Outdoor Oasis:**
Private heated swimming pool, private terrace, and a beautifully landscaped private garden offering ample space for both play and relaxation.

- **Amenities & Tech:**
Fully equipped kitchen (ceramic hob, microwave, dishwasher, oven, fridge), ample living room centered around a cozy wood-burning fireplace, flat-screen Smart TV, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, Nespresso coffee maker, and private parking.

- **Security & Logistics:**
Absolute discretion via a gated layout, private access paths, and 24-hour Marbella Club resort security protection.

- **Included Services:**
Dedicated elite Villa Host service included, daily housekeeping, professional resort concierge services, and daily gourmet breakfast.

- **Resort Privileges:**
Immediate access to the Marbella Club’s legendary amenities, including the Thalasso Spa, Holistic Studio, the 5,000 sqm Kids Club, 10 tennis and 4 paddle courts at sister hotel Puente Romano (only a scenic 5-10 minute beach walk away), an elite shopping gallery, equestrian centre, eight celebrated bars and restaurants (including El Patio, The Grill, and Beach Club Buffet), and the Dave Thomas-designed 18-hole golf course within the hills of Benahavís.

- **The Casol Legacy:**
Curated luxury travel services by Casol (established 1985), with optional turnkey curation for your flights, luxury car rentals, and bespoke activities on the Costa del Sol.


## **Villa Policies**

Maximum 6 guests, children welcome, 7 days rental minimum during high season (July and August).

## **Location**

- Puerto Banus: 6 minutes drive.
- Málaga Airport: 40 minutes drive.

## **Rates / Week**

**[Contact Casol now to Rent Your Villa!](https://www.casolvillasfrance.com/luxury-villa-rentals-contact.html "Book Now!")**

Rates include daily breakfast & 10% VAT
